sentences.text: Christie Brinkley -LRB- born Christie Lee Hudson , February 2 , 1954 -RRB- is an American model and actress .	model	model (person)

Brinkley gained worldwide fame beginning in the late 1970s with three consecutive Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue covers through 1981 .	Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue	Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue

She spent twenty five years as the face of CoverGirl -LRB- the longest running cosmetics contract of any model in history -RRB- , has appeared on over 500 magazine covers , and has signed contracts with major brands -- both fashion and non-fashion .	model	model (person)	CoverGirl	CoverGirl

Brinkley went on to work as an actress , illustrator , television personality , photographer , writer , designer , and activist for human and animal rights and the environment .	illustrator	illustrator	activist	activist	environment	Natural environment
Brinkley has been married four times , most notably to musician Billy Joel , several of whose music videos she appeared in .	Billy Joel	Billy Joel
Her fourth marriage , to architect Peter Cook , ended in a much-publicized 2008 divorce .

With a career spanning more than three decades , magazines such as Allure , Playboy , and Men 's Health have named Brinkley one of the most attractive women of all time .	Allure	Allure (magazine)	Playboy	Playboy
Her financial holdings in 2008 were worth an estimated US$ 80 million , primarily as the owner of real estate .
In February 2012 , she was ranked third in the Daily Mail list `` World 's 20 richest models . ''	Daily Mail	Daily Mail
